parallels.note: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the wedding.

translations.web: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren’t worthy.
translations.bsb: Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding banquet is ready, but those I invited were not worthy.
translations.kjv: Then saith he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they which were bidden were not worthy.
